description: This script automates fetching and dependency analysis of Rust packages from crates.io, including downloading, extracting, and dependency resolution via crates.io API.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for package fetching and dependency options.

methods.name: set2list
methods.description: Converts a set to a sorted string list with a leading space.

methods.name: echo
methods.description: Prints informational messages if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: echo_all_deps
methods.description: Displays dependency counts during dependency analysis.

methods.name: pkg_base_name
methods.description: Extracts base package name and version from a package string.

methods.name: get_version_numbers
methods.description: Converts a version string into a tuple of integers.

methods.name: is_newer_version
methods.description: Compares two versions to determine if one is newer.

methods.name: get_max_version
methods.description: Fetches the latest stable version of a package from crates.io.

methods.name: find_dl_path
methods.description: Retrieves the download path for the latest version of a package.

methods.name: fetch_pkg
methods.description: Downloads, extracts, and optionally processes a Rust package from crates.io.

methods.name: get_crate_dependencies
methods.description: Retrieves dependencies of a crate from crates.io.

methods.name: compare_pkg_deps
methods.description: Defines dependency order between two packages based on their dependencies.

methods.name: sort_found_pkgs
methods.description: Performs a topological sort of packages based on dependencies.

methods.name: show_all_dependencies
methods.description: Displays sorted dependency information and counts.

methods.name: show_dependencies
methods.description: Main function to display dependencies of specified packages.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to parse arguments and perform package fetching or dependency analysis.
